mission: Build powerful and elegant models that represent the material and its relationships.

goals.name: Traceable
goals.text: A reader walks back to source one visible stop at a time.

goals.name: Mechanical
goals.text: A process can be improved if it is reproducible and interpretable.

goals.name: Attributable
goals.text: Judgment is declared where it is applied.

goals.name: Compact
goals.text: Focused ideas are modular and preserve context.

goals.name: Connected
goals.text: We see the relationships between ideas.
